evidence: Every surface is a unit cube with a 16x16 texel texture magnified with nearest-neighbour filtering: texels read as crisp square pixels on grass, dirt, cobblestone, planks, logs and leaves
Geometry is perfectly stable from frame to frame; blocks drop in on a schedule with an identical bounce and squash, no morphing, no texture boiling
Real-time look: one directional sun with soft shadow maps, hemisphere fill, distance fog to a flat sky gradient; no global illumination or depth of field
Title is a webfont pixel typeface composited on top with a hard offset drop shadow; letters drop in one by one with stepped positions
The tool read sensor noise; it is the dense per-texel colour variation of the procedural textures and the grass tufts, not noise
shots.description: One continuous real-time voxel scene (three.js, procedurally textured cubes). A terraced grassy hill of block steps (green speckled tops, brown speckled dirt sides with a jagged green fringe) in a flat grass field dotted with crossed-quad grass tufts and tiny pixel flowers (red, yellow, blue), blocky oak trees (log trunk, cube-cluster leaf crowns) near and far, a sky that is a vertical gradient from a horizon blue-white to a mid blue at the top, distance fog, flat white blocky cloud slabs drifting. A small building assembles itself block by block in the centre: a grey cobblestone foundation ring sweeps round, then a plank floor, then three courses of plank walls with dark log corner posts, glass window panes and a door gap, then a stepped gable roof of dark red-brown planks sweeping left and right row by row, then a cobblestone chimney; the last chimney block slams down from high up at 2.7 s with a puff of about 36 small grey-white dust cubes, a small camera shake, the windows and doorway light up warm orange in three quick steps, and grey smoke cubes rise and drift from the chimney. Each block falls about 2.4 block heights, scaling from 0.5 to 1 with a small spin, then lands with a squash-and-stretch wobble. Camera orbits about 57 degrees round the build while craning down from about 29 to 11 degrees elevation and pushing in, then settles. Text: a lowercase white pixel-font line at the top (y about 345, 92 px) whose letters drop in one by one with a stepped bounce, fading out at 2.6 s; a second, bigger one-word line (150 px) slams in with a scale overshoot at the same moment as the last block.

narrative.point: A thing assembles itself piece by piece in layers, from foundation to the last piece, and the last piece landing lights it up as the one-word payoff lands.

style.render_style: Blocky voxel world in the look of a block-building game: every object is built from unit cubes, each face carrying a 16x16 pixel texture drawn in code and magnified without smoothing; real-time lighting with a sun, sky fill, fog and soft shadows
style.outline: none: cube edges read by the value step between faces (top lightest, sides darker)
style.shading: per-face flat lighting: top faces lightest, sun-facing side mid, the far side darkest, plus soft cast shadows; texture texels vary brightness by about +-10% inside each face
style.shape_language: strictly cubic and grid-aligned: terraces stepping by one block, trees as a log column with a cross-shaped cluster of leaf cubes, clouds as flat slabs on a coarse grid, smoke and dust as small tumbling cubes
style.texture: procedural 16x16 texels: grass top speckled 6 greens, grass side dirt with a jagged green drip fringe 3 to 5 texels deep, cobblestone as irregular grey stones with dark mortar, planks as 4 horizontal boards with darker seams and staggered butt joints, logs as vertical bark stripes with ring end grain, leaves dark speckled greens with see-through holes, glass a pale frame with diagonal glints
style.type_ui: one lowercase white pixel-font line at the top centre (92 px, letters dropping in with 6 px steps), then a one-word payoff line at 150 px slamming in with a scale overshoot; each with a hard dark-brown drop shadow offset 7 to 10 px down-right; no panels or boxes
style.motion_style: blocks fall about 2.4 block heights in 0.2 s, scale 0.5 to 1, a small spin, then squash and stretch on landing (exponentially damped); builds in layers in sweeping order; a slow eased camera orbit and crane; the last piece slams from higher with a camera shake and a dust puff; lights switch on in steps
style.signature: The thing builds itself block by block, layer by layer, and the last block landing turns on the warm light and the payoff word
style.do_not_copy: the topic and objects (a house or cottage with a chimney and smoke), the words "block by block" and "home."; Mojang textures, logos and characters; there is no watermark or handle

story.summary: A 4 s satisfying build: a small structure assembles itself block by block on a grassy voxel hill while the camera orbits, and lands on a one-word payoff when the last block slams in and the lights come on.
story.hook: 0 to 0.5 s: the first stone blocks are already dropping into a ring on an empty hilltop, so the eye locks on the build; the title letters start dropping in at 0.3 s.
highlights: Every block lands with a bounce and squash (0 to 2.5 s): the build itself is the motion, so the frame is never still and the progress is visible at a glance.
Layer order (foundation, floor, walls, roof, last block) makes the build read as a process the viewer can predict and enjoy completing.
The last block is staged as an event at 2.7 s (dropped from twice as high, camera shake, dust puff) and triggers the payoff: lights on, smoke, a big one-word title.
The orbiting, craning camera turns a top-down view into a front portrait of the finished build, so the end frame is a hero shot.
